Tooltip_SVSBT_SealedBiologicalSample: A fictionalized sealed research sample. Ultra-rare as loot, or cultured from fish guts in a sealed jar; used by the mod's abstract biological-agent recipe.
Tooltip_SVSBT_WaterBucketTrap: A full bucket, rope, and mounting hardware, set on a tile. Soaks whoever steps on it. Single-use.
Tooltip_SVSBT_ShotgunDoorTrap: A loaded shotgun rigged to fire when its tile is disturbed. Lethal and single-use.
Tooltip_SVSBT_TripWireKit: Two stakes wired to a battery, ready to stretch between your current tile and a second point. Anyone crossing the line sounds a real house alarm and alerts you -- no damage. Good for 3 real detonations, with a 2 hour cooldown between each, before it burns out.
Tooltip_SVSBT_MadMagazine10: Read this issue to learn how to rig a shotgun door trap. Carpentry 3 and Aiming 3 are still required to build it.
Tooltip_SVSBT_NailBoard: A visible entry-level floor trap. It wounds feet, damages footwear, and may puncture a vehicle tire.
Tooltip_SVSBT_BearTrap: A reusable but fragile steel trap. Setting and resetting it can injure an arm, especially at low Trapping/Welding skill or poor condition.
Tooltip_SVSBT_ExplosiveParcel: A concealed parcel that can be hidden in a real mailbox, trash can, or dumpster. Opening an uninspected one gives an extremely short warning before detonation.
Tooltip_SVSBT_AnthraxAgent: A fictionalized gameplay agent that can contaminate one readable document. Exposure causes immediate injury and prolonged sickness; it cannot spread between players.
Tooltip_SVSBT_IgnitionCharge: A concealed vehicle charge triggered by the next engine start.
Tooltip_SVSBT_DriverSeatDyeTrap: A one-use vehicle trap that wounds the next driver and leaves them visibly blood-soaked and stained for the configured duration. Rebuilt from a screwdriver, a 9mm bullet, duct tape, a rubber band, and a metal pipe.
Tooltip_SVSBT_VehicleTamperAlarm: A concealed alarm covering the whole car -- any seat, door, window, storage access, or popped hood. Installation provides a paired controller.
Tooltip_SVSBT_RemoteImmobilizer: A concealed device that remotely shuts down and blocks a vehicle engine once its controller is synced. Installing it hands over a blank controller -- sync it nearby, then it works from anywhere as a simple on/off switch.
Tooltip_SVSBT_BoobyTrapController: Paired automatically to a tamper alarm at installation. For an immobilizer it comes blank and must be synced within range before it can do anything -- once synced, it works from anywhere and never shows the vehicle's location. Signal jammers can block an alarm's remote command or alert path.

Tooltip_SVSBT_MadMagazine2: Read this issue to learn how to build a Nail Board and forge a Bear Trap. Carpentry 4 (Nail Board) or Trapping 3 and Welding 5 (Bear Trap) are still required to craft either.
